mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.UNIV_ID, MD.DEPT_ID, M.PASSWORD, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.ROLE, M.PHONE_NUMBER, M.GENDER, M.STATUS, M.CREATED_AT, M.LOGTIME_AT, M.BIRTH, MD.COMMUNITY_NICKNAME FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL MD ON M.MEMBER_ID = MD.MEMBER_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_ID, PASSWORD, MEMBER_NAME, ROLE, PHONE_NUMBER, GENDER, STATUS, CREATED_AT, LOGTIME_AT, BIRTH ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{password}, #{memberName}, #{role}, #{phoneNumber}, #{gender}, #{status}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{birth} )
